name: Mortis (Path of the Four Humours) — Advanced — Black Breath

system.description: You can awaken the melancholy black bile festering in your core and expel it with your breath as a miasmic black cloud that chokes everyone around you with malaise and depression. Expend a Willpower Trait and a Blood Trait to prepare the bile, then exhale. The Black Breath affects everyone within five yards in the direction you face, though those caught within may attempt a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty five Traits) to dodge out unless trapped. Those who come into contact must make a Mental Challenge against your Mental Traits; those who fail are seized by overwhelming depression for the remainder of the scene, their Willpower Traits considered halved (round down, minimum one) for Trait comparison, and they cannot burn Blood to increase Physical Traits. Some may contemplate or attempt suicide, with Storyteller-prompted recurrences over the next couple of nights; mortals will generally attempt meaningful suicide unless prevented, and Cainites slip into torpor per their Road rating. You feel exhilarated and almost cheerful for the rest of the scene, having expelled your melancholy.
system.duration: Remainder of the scene (victims); several nights of recurrence
